buyer_question: My clinic misses patient calls after hours; what should I check before buying an AI receptionist?
safe_aics_answer: Start with a no-patient-data missed-call evidence review: source of enquiry, callback owner, age of callback, resolution status, safe WhatsApp handoff and unresolved reason. AICS can help build that owner-control layer before tool selection.
proof_asset_to_show: Clinic after-hours checklist; synthetic callback queue fields; owner dashboard requirements
human_review_gate: Any urgent, clinical, emergency, privacy, insurance, payment or complaint message must go to trained staff or qualified advisers before automation.
claims_not_allowed: Guaranteed appointments; patient outcomes; clinical triage; HIPAA/GDPR/DPDP/PIPEDA/PHIPA compliance; real client results; revenue or ROI

buyer_question: How do I know whether after-hours calls are leaking appointments?
safe_aics_answer: Use an evidence queue for 30 days: missed-call time, source, staff owner, callback attempts, WhatsApp/form handoff, booking status and lost/pending reason. Treat this as readiness evidence, not proof of growth.
proof_asset_to_show: 30-day pilot evidence pack; callback SLA checklist; lead leakage calculator route
human_review_gate: Owner or manager reviews ambiguous rows and approves any external message wording.
claims_not_allowed: Booking lift; conversion improvement; savings; ranking; demand; lead volume; patient identity

buyer_question: Should WhatsApp follow-up be automated for missed clinic calls?
safe_aics_answer: Automate only approved non-clinical acknowledgements and reminders after consent/process review. Keep clinical questions, urgent cases, complaints and personal data requests in human review.
proof_asset_to_show: WhatsApp handoff checklist; consent prompt map; human escalation route
human_review_gate: Qualified privacy/legal/clinical review is needed for region-specific consent, call recording, advertising and patient-data rules.
claims_not_allowed: Legal/privacy advice; compliance certification; medical advice; platform partnership; deliverability guarantee

buyer_question: What should a clinic owner dashboard show before more ad spend?
safe_aics_answer: Show missed enquiries by source, overdue callbacks, unresolved reasons, staff owner, appointment status, safe-message coverage and ageing queue. This helps decide whether ads, CRM, call-centre or AI receptionist spend is premature.
proof_asset_to_show: Owner dashboard field list; weekly decision memo; free review route
human_review_gate: Owner signs off on dashboard definitions before using it for staff performance, ad decisions or vendor comparison.
claims_not_allowed: Staff blame; fraud claims; ad performance claims; guaranteed patient growth; marketing ROI

buyer_question: Can AICS replace my clinic software or call centre?
safe_aics_answer: No. AICS should complement existing PMS/EMR/CRM/call-centre workflows by mapping leakage, ownership and safe automation boundaries before platform changes.
proof_asset_to_show: AICS role boundary; FAQ; proof policy
human_review_gate: Production integrations, patient data access and vendor changes require approved scope and appropriate advisers.
claims_not_allowed: Replacement/superiority claims; certifications; undisclosed clients; production access readiness
